Name: Harvest_Feast_Weaver
$Comment: Elsie the Weaver's conversation, one of the three villagers standing in the Forgotten Temple while
Harvest Feast runs. Elsie never contracts: I am, it is, do not.
Start's First beats come first. The off-season beat answers a visit while the feast is off (after a
command ends it, or when a server owner stands Elsie somewhere all year) with one line and goodbye. A
conversation has no Season leaf, so it reads the feature ziggfreedcommon:feature Harvest_Feast_Live,
Quests holds two rows. Supper for Elsie (harvest_feast_supper_elsie), the plate Martha sends her after
The Feast, names only its Ready screen: while the player carries it with the roast vegetable in the
bag, the conversation opens on supper, her thanks, whose answer hands it over. Then her daily, Daily
Spices (harvest_feast_weaver_spices): the conversation opens on its offer while it can be taken, on
its brief while it is carried, and on its hand-in once the spices are in the bag. Each hand-in opens
her quest list with Collect in front of the player, and collecting plays this conversation again
(each quest's CompletionDialogue). Otherwise it opens on greeting, the Fallback. Greeting and the
spices brief lead with What needs doing? (Open Quests: the quest list of the character in front of
the player, so her daily and her supper), then her tip on where Spices come from (the spice screen).
The invitation tour's line is not in this file: DialogueExtensions/SeasonsOfOrbis/
Harvest_Feast_Invitation.json adds it to the screens a conversation opens on while the player carries
the tour, after a screen's own lines and before the goodbye group, so goodbye stays last. That line
is spent once a day per conversation, which is why each villager has a conversation of their own.
